notes: Observed fields come from constructor/destructor/serializer/vtable method accesses; serialized fields come from writer order.
A field can be observed but not serialized because it is derived, transient, or stored in a nested object/global block.
City is serialized by MapObjectList_Save/MapObjectList_Load; the writer name is legacy.
WorldObject is the base vtable used by Person records, serialized through PersonList_Save/PersonAction_LoadState.
